title: Volvo 940 Turbo JZ
summary: Volvo 940 Turbo -97, B230FK modified with new parts running a MEGA144H7 + Speeduino 0.4.3c combo, along with DCWerX mosfet adapter boards.
author: JawZ
notes:
Volvo 940 Turbo LPT 1997, B230FK

Block; Crank - Stock
Rods - Stock
Pistons - Stock
Piston Squirters - Yes
Oil pump - Stock
Oil pan - Stock
Crank Pulley - Stock
Pump Drive Axle - Stock (No cast port for CAM signal)

Cylinderhead;
530 Intake ports - Stage 1 ported
Exhaust ports - Stage 1 ported
Camshaft - Volvo V camshaft
Valve Springs - Stock
Valve Retainers - Stock
Cooling passages - Drilled up Group A Rally ports
Thermostat port - Mild ported
Oil passages - Stock
Decked - 0.6mm
Combustion Chamber - Re-shaped with ~52cc volume
Cam gear - Stock
Cam Trigger - Yes DIY, on camshaft

Ignition;
Distribution - Wasted Spark (OEM VWAG 106B coil)
Cables - Silicone high insulation cables
Spark Plugs - NGK BPR6ES, 0.6mm gap
Powerstage - Built-in into coil pack

Fuel;
Fuel pump - Walbro 255 L/H
Injectors - Bosch 550cc 0280158117
FPR - Stock @3bar
Fuel lines - Stock
Fuel Filter - Mini 30 micron with replacable metal filter
Tank - Stock
Fuel rail - Stock

Intake;
Manifold - Stock B230 LH 2.4
Charge pipes - 2.5" alu and silicone hoses
Intercooler - 73mm thick 550x300x76 2.5" piping, Bar & Plate
Turbo Intake - Custom DIY Air Filter - Custom cold air intake filter, cold air through fenders
Throttle Body - Audi A6 electric Idle control (65mm inner Ø)

Exhaust;
Turbo - TD04-13T
Manifold - Stock 940
Exhaust system - Custom DIY 3" Muffler - Biltema 3" short Cat. - 3" 100 cell race cat.
O2 sensor - Innovate LC-1
EGT - No
Backpressure sensors - No
